name: Progress Bar Blocks for Gutenberg
author: jobayer534

sections.description:
Create beautiful and customizable progressmatify bars and skill indicators with this powerful Gutenberg block plugin.

Key Features of Progressmatify

  • Multiple Progressmatify Bars – Add unlimited progressmatify bars to showcase different skills or metrics
  • Customizable Design – Full control over colors, sizes, and styles
  • Percentage Display – Show progressmatify percentage for each bar
  • Label Support – Add custom labels to identify each progressmatify bar
  • Toggle Labels – Option to show or hide labels for cleaner designs
  • Fully Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices and screen sizes
  • Lightweight & Fast – Optimized for performance with clean code
  • Easy to Use – Intuitive interface built with Gutenberg standards
  • No Coding Required – Simple drag-and-drop interface
  • Real-time Preview – See changes instantly in the editor
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/progressmatify directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Are the blocks Responsive?

Yes, the blocks are responsive.

Are they optimized for Speed?

Yes, they are optimized for speed.
